title: OpenAI Makes a Big Move, Will Offer GPT-5.6 Series Free to 100,000 Scientists!
excerpt: Recently, OpenAI officially launched the "ChatGPT for Academic Researchers" program. This initiative aims to provide researchers with stronger technical support
content_html:
Recently, OpenAI officially launched the "ChatGPT for Academic Researchers" program. This initiative aims to provide researchers with stronger technical support. Initially, it will be available to 10,000 researchers at selected universities, and will gradually expand to 100,000 researchers in the future.

According to this program, researchers who are selected will receive an advanced version of ChatGPT with higher usage limits and a larger context window. In addition, each participant can invite four colleagues from their institution to enjoy the same benefits for free. Meanwhile, OpenAI also plans to introduce extended research features for the chatbot, helping researchers gain more efficient insights into topics from specific sources such as scientific journals.

content_html_zh:
近日，OpenAI 正式启动“ChatGPT 学术研究人员”计划。 该举措旨在为研究人员提供更有力的技术支持。 最初将向选定大学的 10,000 名研究人员开放，未来将逐步扩大到 100,000 名研究人员。

根据该计划，被选中的研究人员将获得 ChatGPT 的高级版本，具有更高的使用限制和更大的上下文窗口。 此外，每位参与者还可以邀请所在机构的四名同事免费享受同样的福利。 同时，OpenAI 还计划为聊天机器人引入扩展研究功能，帮助研究人员更有效地了解科学期刊等特定来源的主题。
